notes: v1.10.9 - Variables in a pattern: a trigger or alias pattern can name a variable - ${targ} arrives. - and the rule follows whatever the variable holds; ${name} is matched as plain text, ${!name} as regex (a list like Eldran|Bjorn), an unset one matches nothing, and the MUSHclient import converts its "expand variables" rules. Capture panes can dock above the output (Move to top on a pane tab's right-click menu), and closing a floated pane's window puts it back where it was docked. Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab switch between connected characters. .gmcp fields prints the newest different payloads of a package as well as the first twelve, so a change late in a long session is shown and not only counted. Plugins since 1.10.8: 3S Crafting 0.3.0 is new - a HUD for the crafting system (storage, souls, the queue, builds with a countdown, every building with its tier, skills, tokens, the token market and the recipe catalogue); click a building for cbuild info, right-click to build or upgrade it; 3S Map 1.21.0 names favourites (mapg favname) and merges the map file when several characters are open, where one used to overwrite the other's exploring; Farmer 1.11.1 shows what each setting is set…
